findings.finding: Number-name examples omitted low numbers and always used choice recognition for numeral-to-word questions.
findings.resolution: Full zero-to-cap range; alternating typed name, choice recognition and numeral writing. Standard hyphen/space/optional-and variants accepted.
findings.verification: numberNames.test.ts: independent English-number reader; all P1 values 0–100 reached across 3000 seeds; all number-name objectives checked.

findings.finding: Order-of-operations objectives mentioned brackets but generated no bracketed expression to solve.
findings.resolution: Both (a+b)×c and a×(b+c), plus unbracketed a+b×c; expression table and targeted correction.
findings.verification: syllabusRegressions.test.ts: independent operator-stack evaluation across 1200 examples.

findings.finding: Both factors were always proper, omitting official proper×improper and (Standard) improper×improper.
findings.resolution: Required combinations cycle; Foundation excludes improper×improper. Actual improper values appear in a fraction table.
findings.verification: syllabusRegressions.test.ts: visible numerator/denominator cross-products across 4800 examples.

findings.finding: A four-digit quotient was multiplied by the divisor, allowing five-digit dividends.
findings.resolution: Bound dividend to 1000–9999; quotient bounds derived from divisor.
findings.verification: 2000 seeds per P3/P4 division objective; visible dividend range and quotient×divisor independently checked.

findings.finding: Selector recognised “divide” but not “division”; related fact objectives produced multiplication only.
findings.resolution: Division-symbol objective produces division; related multiplication/division objectives alternate.
findings.verification: 100 seeds per related-facts objective, both operations and visible arithmetic checked.

findings.finding: Some explanations equated decimal×100 to a percentage, e.g. 0.2×100=20%, confusing a number with a percent value.
findings.resolution: Use 0.2=20/100=20%; percentage-change explanations use the fraction/decimal ratio before the percentage.
findings.verification: Numeric worked-step audit with percent values interpreted as /100.

findings.finding: Nonterminating averages such as 22÷3 were shown with exact =7.33.
findings.resolution: Use ≈ for rounded averages, = only when exact.
findings.verification: Numeric worked-step audit parses exact equalities only.

findings.finding: Existing guided core decomposes numbers and uses counters/bars; it does not demonstrate a written column algorithm for every required grade.
findings.needed: P1/P2 addition/subtraction column extensions are now present as separately tested lessons. P3/P4 multiplication/division and P3/5F written algorithms still need dedicated instructional coverage.

findings.finding: Dedicated comparison objective asks symbolic numeral comparisons; number-of-objects comparison across two or more pictured sets is not established by that lesson.
findings.needed: Explicit matching/comparison of two and three object sets, including equal sets.

findings.finding: Comparison generates two fractions and a relation symbol. Ordering three or more fractions is not supplied by the dedicated comparison objective.
findings.needed: Order unit/like fractions in P2 and unlike fractions in P3/5F with denominators≤12, using equal wholes.

findings.finding: P1 length examples read a zero-aligned ruler; P2 measurement examples subtract two stated measurements. Actual measured scale-reading and ordering three measurements need broader evidence.
findings.needed: Non-zero starts, scales for appropriate instruments, and order multiple lengths/masses/volumes within the stated level.

findings.finding: P1 compose/decompose generated examples ask only how many quarter-circles form a half/whole circle.
findings.needed: Compose/decompose rectangles, squares and triangles as well as circular parts with actual manipulation.

findings.finding: Drawing objectives mostly assess recognition or give a paper-construction task to be checked by an adult. Recognition questions do not verify the pupil constructed the target.
findings.needed: Interactive ruler/protractor/grid construction with constraints checked, or clear practical-task coverage labelling. Existing free drawing pad alone is not mathematical assessment.

findings.finding: Complete-symmetry objective asks the distance of a single reflected point from a vertical line.
findings.needed: Complete and check a whole figure on a square grid, with varied mirror-line positions.

findings.finding: Dedicated composite-circle generator always uses a rectangle topped by a semicircle.
findings.needed: Original composite families incorporating square/triangle/quarter-circle cases, curved boundary vs internal join reasoning, and useful diagrams.

findings.finding: Generated volume examples use cm³ or unit cubes; objectives mention m³ but systematic m³ questions were not demonstrated in sampled lesson items.
findings.needed: Include m³ as a cubic unit at appropriate scale, explicitly excluding cm³↔m³ conversion.
